title: Link to the searching guides on the specific widgets/connectors doc
body:
I had a live-chat today, where the user had an issue with the pagination because it did not calculate the correct number of pages.

In the end, it was a limitation from Algolia API documented here (https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/searching/pagination/#pagination-limitations) in which its automatically limit the max nbPages to 34.

The user suggested to link this kind of searching guides to the connectors/widgets pages to learn more on how it works behind and avoid this kind of frustration thinking that Algolia is broken.

What do you think @Haroenv @bobylito ?
